args.title: Enable drag-and-drop file upload on the upload form
args.body:
File: src/ui/components/UploadForm.tsx

Add support for dropping a statement file directly onto the upload form. This change allows users to drag files from the desktop or their mail app and drop them to upload, streamlining the month-end workflow by eliminating the repetitive file dialog step.
